test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sites is NOT a part of the Indus Valley Civilization?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uruk**__.

__
 
• The main sites of the Indus Valley Civilization are Rakhigarhi (first site with genetic testing), Sanauli, Farmana, Kalibangan, **Lothal**__, Dholavira, Mehrgarh, __**Harappa**__, Chanhudaro and __**Mohenjo-Daro**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uruk, also known as Warka or Warkah, was an ancient city of Sumer (and later of Babylonia) situated east of the present bed of the Euphrates River** on the dried-up ancient channel of the Euphrates 30 km east of modern Samawah, Al-Muthannā, Iraq.

 
 
• Uruk is the type site for the Uruk period.
